logp.method_description: To determine the log D values for compounds 1, 2, and 4, their partitioning between 0.9% saline (pH 5.8) and 1-octanol was assessed spectrophotometrically. Extractions and absorbance measurements were performed with 50 µM solutions in saline, saturated with 1-octanol for 16 h, on a Cary 100 UV–visible spectrophotometer (Agilent Technologies) at λmax = 413 nm with ε413 = 104 M-1 cm-1. Equal volumes of saline solution and 1-octanol were vortexed at room temperature until a constant absorbance reading was obtained (approximately 10 min). The values were calculated using Eq. (1) and are reported as averages of a minimum of three determinations.
